name: @immunity-wars/equivalence
description: Task B equivalence rig: proves the ported engine behaves identically to tools/legacy/v2_engine.js
comment:exports: The rig modules other suites reuse. Task D's property suite needs the sequence generator, the seeded RNG, the order-sensitive comparator and the shrinker; Task E's balance harness needs the same four. Exporting them beats copying them into each suite, which is how two generators drift apart and stop agreeing about what a legal game is. Deliberately NOT exported: rig.ts (its normalise() strips the DELIBERATE_DIVERGENCES and is meaningful only for legacy-vs-port comparison) and states.ts (its augmented states are deliberately incoherent — see the property suite's README).
